contract: Qwen 0.22 buildInvocation may reject invalid tool params before PreToolUse. Only authoritative awaited PostToolBatch evidence with exact provider tool_call_id, status=error, error_type=invalid_tool_params, execution_status=not_started may discharge that hookless expectation.
Every started/executed/successful tool still requires its completed or explicitly denied Pre/Post pair. Generic errors and next-request text never waive hooks.

Expected IDs must be the disjoint union of completed pairs and preexecution rejections. Reject overlaps, unexpected/duplicate IDs, malformed state, missing batch, and batch hook crashes before any next provider contact.

Retain raw PostToolBatch input and bind rejection state, raw journal hashes, separate completed/rejected counts into signed terminal receipt. Terminal auditor independently re-derives exact rejection state from raw bytes.
No runtime v45 changes and no grace window/aggregate cap.
